summary: Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature without running any tests, as instructed. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk, 4-cell indent per level, min/max over labels) and imports Measurement; rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width) in the render path, and adds the VerticalCenter class with repr, rendering via newline-segment padding, and measurement; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in the render options for collected renderables while keeping justify in collection. CHANGELOG.md 9.8.0 is marked Unreleased with an Added subheading holding the two entries and the existing markdown entry. tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render, and measurement tests; tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement after console and adds a measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19). Nothing was committed. Outcome is unverified: the tests have not been run, so the new expectations (VerticalCenter render output, tree measurement values) are checked only by reading the code.
